body: # ${1:NAME} (General Description). ${2:What it does, where it finds its
# material and where it leaves the result.}
Table.description: A table with its general description, ending as a subsidiary does

Subsidiary.description: Start a subsidiary operation: bury a note of where we are, then go to the table

Return.description: End a subsidiary: go back to the note last buried

Transfer.description: Transfer one storage to another, through TS 6

Fetch.description: Transfer a minor cycle of a delay line into a temporary storage

Store.description: Transfer a temporary storage into a minor cycle of a delay line

Content.description: Give a minor cycle its content before the start: a number, a word or an instruction

Word.description: A minor cycle written out, digit 1 first

body: B, BURY;  B, DISCRIM;  TS 24 - TS 6;  B, 1
Choice.description: Go one way if TS 8 has any digit 1, the other if not: the instructions are kept at the two detail figures

Punch.description: Punch a whole number in decimal on a card

Read.description: Read the card in the reader into the first 12 minor cycles of a delay line

Stop.description: An instruction that proceeds with itself: the job is over
